D.t: Jim Clyburn leads by 49.6 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 145,532 votes; a one point swing is about 1,468 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +39.7 and D +59.0. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
